system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Define one complete robotics scenario named DeltaPositionF for the closed-chain robotic mechanism domain. Mission: Move the output platform to a nonzero pose and hold it against a bounded load. Embodiment: A fixed triangular base carries three actuated 0.32 m upper arms and paired 0.60 m forearms connected to a 3 kg moving platform by revolute and spherical joints. Actuation: Three base-joint torque actuators position the platform, and do not exceed 54.9 N.m-per-actuator. Observation: Measure all actuator coordinates, output pose, and reaction forces. Operating context: Use rigid base geometry and enable self-collision checks between struts or links. Control: use pose feedback through constrained inverse kinematics. Robustness case: apply a controlled 20.3 N platform load disturbance during the middle third. Timing and evidence: Run at 500 Hz for 20 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Verification criteria: Require actuator travel and force bounds, all closure residuals, pose error, and no self-collision, primary tracking error below 0.005 m pose error after 13 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
